entries.summary: Keep terminal proof/assumption/provenance inspection available even without an underline. The exact terminal treatment is a proposal, not an amendment silently imposed on the author.

Distinguish authentication, authorization and source authenticity; use permission-sensitive, non-quantitative redaction where length/existence is protected. This is not a finding that unknown or withheld information is absent. Material perimeter/background choices remain open.

Separate receiving authored emotion from the system's evidence-bearing rhetoric; define current/prior/assisted consent and voluntary support. Non-scalar composition is explicitly sourced in U07, while these operational elaborations remain proposals.

Use a common admission principle with separately justified contrast, route-reliability and consent checks. Compare an exact alternative bridge rather than treating this assistant preference as settled or allowing a score to supply consent.

Distinguish proof-based, evidence-based and agreement-based resolution. Retain objections after scoped adoption; the particular collective procedure is human-chosen, not forbidden or selected by this ledger.

Distinguish manufacturers' physical/platform power from legitimate authority over a person's interface. This is a proposed reading of the source tension, not an adopted replacement of the author's words.

Separate an under-refined application locality from actual resource/protocol failures. Compare deterministic exact lookup with ark-only learned orientation; do not silently defer the requested learned capability or invent an available destination.

Give drafts, originals, publications, derivations and replicas distinct lifecycles; define tensor-free distribution operationally rather than treating tensor removal as privacy, correctness or permission. No retention or shared-work grant is supplied.

Examine expression/grounds/authorization/rendering as four records and certificate-relative sufficiency as a possible mathematical analogy. Selecting observable distinctions is a human question; the analogy is not an established theorem about people.
Consider prospectively authorized classes of bounded reversible mechanical repairs to reduce approval burden. No standing repair/merge grant or retrospective waiver is created by this suggestion.

Allow local reader revisions while preserving authors' source boundaries, omissions and endings. Exact source/revision/claim correspondence and public disclosure need separate treatment; no participant is assigned an unsourced position.

Use the authored internal lineage alongside external philosophical interlocutors. The prior assistant synthesis is a research proposal, not evidence of influence, author-approved voice or permission to republish a private narrative.
